subject: VPN won't connect — shift starts in 20 minutes
body: My laptop cannot connect to the VPN. I need remote access to the EHR to review patient assignments before my shift. Shift starts in 20 minutes. This is urgent.

subject: Office printer not working
body: The printer on the 3rd floor keeps saying 'paper jam' but there is no paper jam. I restarted it twice. Not urgent, just annoying.

subject: I may have sent patient data to the wrong email
body: I accidentally sent a spreadsheet with patient names and diagnosis codes to an external email address. It was meant for our compliance team internally. I think it may contain PHI. What do I do?

subject: Clicked a suspicious link in an email
body: I received an email that looked like it was from IT saying my password was expiring. I clicked the link and entered my credentials before I realized it might be a phishing attempt. My computer is behaving strangely now.

subject: Medication dosing software crashed mid-order
body: The medication order entry software crashed while I was entering an order for a patient in the ED. I had to write it on paper for now but this is a patient safety issue. Need this resolved immediately.

subject: Can't open Excel files from shared drive
body: Since yesterday I can't open any Excel files stored on the shared drive. I get an error saying the file format is not supported. I need these for end-of-month reporting.

subject: Computer acting weird
body: My computer is slow and sometimes the screen flickers. It started maybe two weeks ago. I don't know if it's the hardware or the software. It doesn't really affect my work too much but it's getting worse.

subject: Need access to EHR audit logs for HIPAA investigation
body: I am conducting an internal HIPAA compliance investigation and need read-only access to the EHR audit logs for the past 90 days. This involves reviewing access to medical records for a specific patient. Please treat as confidential.

subject: Forgot my password
body: I forgot my Windows login password. I haven't logged in for two weeks because I was on leave. Can someone reset it for me?

subject: Badge reader on medication room door not working
body: The badge reader on the controlled substance medication room is not responding to my badge. I cannot access medications I need to dispense for patients. I tried my badge on other doors and it works fine. This needs to be fixed now.

subject: RANSOMWARE MESSAGE on my screen
body: I turned on my computer this morning and there is a message on my screen saying all my files are encrypted and I need to pay bitcoin. I have NOT clicked anything. The screen is just showing this message. All capital letters because this is very serious. I have disconnected my ethernet cable.

subject: Microsoft Teams keeps crashing
body: Teams crashes every time I try to join a meeting. I've tried reinstalling it. This is my second ticket about this — I submitted one last week (TKT-087) and the fix didn't stick.

subject: New employee onboarding — account setup
body: New hire starting Monday: Rosa Gutierrez, Nurse Practitioner, Oncology. Needs EHR access, VPN, and email. Please create accounts before her start date.

subject: PACS imaging software extremely slow
body: The PACS system (medical imaging software) is loading images very slowly — taking 3-4 minutes per image. I have a full schedule of reads today. This isn't a full outage but it's significantly slowing clinical workflow. The images are loading correctly, just slowly.

subject: Laptop won't turn on
body: My work laptop will not power on at all. I pressed the power button multiple times. The charging light comes on when plugged in but it still won't boot. I need my laptop for end-of-day inventory.
